result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that renders mostly well. Found a few minor layout issues related to content clipping at horizontal scroll edges.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the 'Trattoria Piccol...' card on the right edge is cut off, with truncated text and a partially visible image.
issues.suggestion: This is expected for a scrollable carousel, but consider adding a peek/fade indicator or consistent card padding so users clearly understand there is more content to scroll.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated abruptly without an ellipsis, which may look unintentional.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis (…) for names that overflow their container.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza with -20% badge) is cut off at the bottom of the viewport, showing only a partial image and no title/details.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the vertical list has adequate bottom spacing above the navigation bar so cards are not ambiguously clipped; this is normal scroll behavior but verify no content is permanently hidden behind the bottom nav.
